attributes.board_name: North Dakota Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops, conferences, seminars and courses from Board-approved providers; formal academic coursework (1 semester credit = 15 contact hours); presenting (hour-per-hour, once per program)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initially licensed January 1 – June 30 of the odd-numbered year: 15 hours; on or after July 1 of an odd-numbered year: none. Hours only after the license effective date.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; hours apply to one licensing period only.
rules.audit_note: Renewal application must include verification of required continuing education.
rules.notes: All licenses expire Dec 31 of odd-numbered years; renewal due by Nov 15 (later = $150 late fee incl. renewal). Max 10 hours independent learning (e.g. online without live interaction).
